## 3. DESCRIPTION (Final Public Copy — Plain Text)
Soft light begins to spill across the room.
The CRT monitor glows quietly at the center of the desk while the sky outside transitions from deep blue into pale lavender and gold. The world isn’t busy yet. The air feels clean. Your thoughts feel lighter. This is the best time to focus.
This 3-hour LoFi + Synthwave mix is designed for calm morning sessions — ideal for coding, studying, writing, and intentional starts to the day.
All music is royalty-free and safe for content creators.
